template.label: Structure template
template.hint: The template sets the starting levels and their numbering. You can then rename them and add more.
template.replaceTitle: Go back to the template levels?
template.replaceDescription: Your custom names and numbering will be replaced by those of the “{{name}}” template. No element of the plan is deleted.

empty.title: Your structure is empty
empty.description: Add a first element at the level that suits you: numbers are computed automatically.

edit.title: Title (optional)
edit.summaryPlaceholder: What happens here, in a few lines.
edit.titlePlaceholder: Without a title, it shows as “{{label}}”
edit.numberedHint: Uncheck for a prologue, an interlude…: it takes no number and does not shift the next ones.
edit.numberInvalid: The number must be a whole number between 0 and {{max}}.

delete.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
delete.withChildren_one: The item it contains will also be deleted.
delete.withChildren_other: The {{count}} items it contains will also be deleted.

levels.title: Structure levels
levels.description: Name each level, choose its numbering and its color. A level's color applies to all its elements, including those created later.
levels.removeDisabled: This level contains elements: move or delete them first.

numbering.title: Automatic numbering
numbering.description: When on, numbers follow the order of the plan: they change by themselves when you add, move or delete an element. When off, each element keeps the number it got when created; you can change it by hand and “Renumber” puts all numbers back in order.
numbering.renumberHint: Put all numbers back in the order of the plan
numbering.confirmDescription: All numbers are put back in the order of the plan, following each level's numbering. Numbers chosen by hand are replaced.
numbering.statusOn: On: numbers follow the order of the plan. When turned off, each element keeps the number it shows.
numbering.statusOff: Off: each element keeps its number.

notFound.title: Element not found
notFound.description: It may have been deleted from the plan.

profile.topLevel: At the top of the plan

characters.title: Characters
characters.noneLeft: All the project's characters are already linked.
characters.noItems: The project has no character yet.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Where “{{name}}” takes place, and the locations mentioned.
locations.noneLeft: All the project's locations are already linked.
locations.noItems: The project has no location yet.

node.insideHint: Linked to a contained element (a scene of this chapter…). “+” links them directly to this element too.

story.title: In the story
story.characterDescription: The plan elements where this character appears.
story.locationDescription: The plan elements that take place in this location or mention it.
story.empty: Not linked to the plan yet: link it from the profile of a chapter, a scene…

colors.inSettings: Level colors are set in the project settings and apply to all their elements.

reading.unplaced_one: {{count}} plot event isn't attached to any outline item: it's left out.
reading.unplaced_other: {{count}} plot events aren't attached to any outline item: they're left out.
reading.emptyHint: Give outline items a summary or a text, file a Word or text document in them, or attach plot events to them.
reading.fromDocuments: Text taken from the item's documents
